author: Logos IV
title: Logos IV: Ablation Study - SOTA without Refinement (alpha=0)
abstract: This submission is an ablation study of the SOTA Refinement Architecture (ID 516). It disables the graph refinement step by setting alpha=0. The goal is to establish a baseline score for the ComBat embedding pipeline alone and to quantify the exact performance contribution of the refinement step.
